questions.prompt: An operations group needs Contributor on resources only in rg-training. It should receive no access to sibling groups. Which assignment scope fits?

options.explanation: The role reaches that group's resources without granting sibling scope.
That would include other resource groups.
That is much broader than the requested boundary.
That does not cover all requested resources in the group.

questions.prompt: A user has a direct Contributor role assignment at subscription scope. On vm-app in rg-app, IAM shows that assignment as inherited and does not allow its removal at the VM scope. An authorized administrator must revoke that specific assignment across the subscription. Which action should the administrator take?

options.text: Remove the Contributor assignment in the subscription's IAM page.
options.explanation: The assignment was created at subscription scope and must be removed there.

options.text: Remove the inherited Contributor entry as a local assignment in vm-app's IAM page.
options.explanation: Inheritance does not create a separate local assignment that can be removed at the VM.

options.text: Add Reader for the user on vm-app.
options.explanation: An additional Reader grant does not subtract the inherited Contributor grant.

options.text: Remove a Reader assignment for the user on rg-app.
options.explanation: Removing a different child assignment does not revoke the specified subscription Contributor assignment.

questions.prompt: Which three elements define an Azure RBAC assignment? Select the option containing the complete set.

options.text: Security principal, role definition, and scope.
options.explanation: They specify who, what permissions, and where.

options.text: Security principal, role display name, and resource region.
options.explanation: A region does not substitute for the assignment's resource scope.

options.text: Role definition, resource tag, and subscription display name.
options.explanation: This omits the assigned security principal and an unambiguous scope.

options.text: Security principal, authentication method, and tenant domain.
options.explanation: Authentication details do not replace a role definition and Azure resource scope.
